reports.headline: Unexplained Destruction {dir_cap} of Village
reports.body: Residents reported seeing a brilliant flash beyond the hills {dir} of the village {dist} shortly before a section of forest was discovered completely destroyed. No fire was found. Witnesses described a single enormous impact. Similar flashes have since been reported farther out.

reports.headline: A Crater Where the Woods Were
reports.body: {name} went out to see the damage {dir} of here {dist} and found a crater the size of a house, glassy at the bottom, the trees around it flattened outward. Nothing burned. Something simply hit the ground harder than anything should.
